rubric.note: Close match to L-board-1 panel 4: a rounded-corner brass cube with a raised brass frame around inset faces, and the frame width and corner radius in proportion. Points lost because the reference's faces sit in a visibly recessed, dark-bevelled well with a chunky softened shell, while the model's inset is shallow, the inner frame edge is hard and the faces read nearly flush (Blender low top view and engine closeup).

Brass body and walnut faces are present (the bible allows walnut), and the pip layout is correct with opposite faces summing to 7. The hero feature of panel 4 is missing: its pips are recessed, glowing amber lights (sampled #FAED6A, S 0.94). The model's pips are flat cream discs with no recess, no emissive and no glow halo (engine #D6C2A4, S 0.38).

The walnut atlas grain is painterly and works. The brass is a uniform factor-only material: no worn edges, no soft value variation (both of which the bible requires) and no edge wear. In engine it reads as smooth gold plastic, olive-tinted in the env sweep. The no-env shot (p5-dice-ingame-d6-no-env-black.jpg) shows the brass dropping to near-black, so its read depends entirely on probes.

The value structure is right: light frame, dark face, light pips. Lit brass measures #988354 to #BEAD82 (S 0.29 to 0.32), about half the saturation of palette polished brass #DEC16A (S about 0.63). Walnut #50372E to #543B2D (hue 15 to 21 degrees) is near oiled walnut #583C26 (hue 26) but slightly redder. The atlas pips have saturated amber cores (#FADA9C, S 0.90), but the rendered pips wash to cream (#D6C2A4), losing the candle amber (#F3BE65) accent entirely.

Pip against walnut, #D6C2A4 vs #50372E, gives a contrast ratio of about 6.3:1. A pip of about 5 to 6 mm on a 40 mm die covers roughly 7 to 14 px at 0.5 to 1 m on Quest 3, so the pips are countable. One point off because this is desktop evidence only.

topFixes: Make the pips emissive candle amber (#F3BE65, about 1.5 to 2x intensity so they glow under tone mapping) and recess them into small cups so they match panel 4's glowing pip wells, instead of flat cream discs.

Replace the factor-only brass with the approved brass-polished set, or add edge-wear and value variation, and lift lit brass saturation toward #DEC16A (S 0.63 against the current 0.29 to 0.32); keep a readable value with no env probe.
Deepen the face inset with a dark bevelled lip between frame and walnut, and darken or desaturate the walnut grain highlights toward #583C26 so the face reads as a dark field behind the amber pips.
